notes.title: 🎉 Introducing "Stick It!" – Now Available! 🎉
notes.notes:
We're excited to finally launch "Stick It!", a physics-based adventure game where you control a stick and master the art of angular momentum to conquer challenging landscapes. Swing, launch, and navigate your way through four distinct areas filled with various platform types, from bouncy surfaces to slippery ice, as you aim to reach the top!

Gameplay Overview:

In "Stick It!", you’ll adjust your rotational speed to jump, swing, and launch yourself across a variety of environments. The unique mechanics and diverse platform properties will test your skills and keep you hooked.

Multiplayer Experience:

You can enjoy "Stick It!" with up to 4 friends locally or compete with up to 6 friends online. The online mode is designed to allow players to race and compete against each other but without direct physical interaction between players' avatars.

For those looking for a more interactive online experience, we’ve got you covered! By using Steam’s Remote Play Together feature, you can invite your friends to join your local session and interact with each other as if you're playing side by side.

Get ready to challenge your skills and conquer the heights!

notes.title: DEMO IS OUT- wait for it... WITH REMOTE PLAY!!!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We are thrilled to announce that the demo of our game, Stick It!, is now available! As the lead developer, I am excited to share a sneak peek of what’s to come in this challenging physics-based platformer.

In this demo, you can explore and conquer the first of the four unique areas that will be featured in the full version of the game: the Sewers. Navigate through tricky obstacles and master the mechanics as you make your way through this gritty, challenging environment.

Stick It! also includes a multiplayer mode, allowing up to 2 players to tackle the challenges together. Although the demo does not support online multiplayer, we have enabled Remote Play, so you can still enjoy a smooth online experience with your friends. This feature ensures that you can connect and play with others seamlessly, even if you’re not in the same room.

We are eagerly awaiting your feedback and hope you enjoy this preview of what Stick It! has to offer. Dive into the Sewers, team up with a friend, and get ready for some chaotic fun. Stay tuned for more updates as we work towards the full release of the game.

Check out our demo on Steam and let us know what you think!

Thank you for your support,
The Jovial Studios Team
